technical.summary: Short-term momentum is bullish with golden cross and rising OBV, but overbought conditions across multiple oscillators and bearish intermediate/long-term structure limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: INTC shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 8 days present elevated volatility risk with no fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear sentiment (37/100) presents contrarian opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news data limit conviction; neutral overall signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (345), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring multinational earnings, with earnings binary event in 8 days compounding volatility risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA 9/21 golden cross with rising RSI 14 and OBV provide short-term momentum confirmation, and extreme fear sentiment (37/100) offers contrarian entry opportunity near support at 37.11.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators across RSI 9/14, Stochastic, and Williams %R combined with price below 200-EMA/SMA, bearish intermediate structure (EMA/SMA 20/50 and 50/200), earnings binary event in 8 days, VIX crisis levels, and unfavorable macro environment create excessive risk that outweighs short-term momentum.

decision.entry_rationale: While EMA 9/21 golden cross and extreme fear sentiment (37/100) offer contrarian appeal, overbought oscillators, bearish intermediate structure, and earnings binary event in 8 days create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs short-term momentum.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings volatility in 8 days combined with VIX crisis levels (345) and price below 200-EMA creates binary event risk with macro headwinds (rising dollar, flat yield curve) limiting upside.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on elevated risk despite technical momentum
decision.portfolio_note: Existing INTC position plus 47 open Information Technology positions create sector concentration; skip reduces redundant exposure and preserves capital for higher-conviction setups.
